scheme_name: Chief Minister Rural Path Vendor Loan Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh
Applicant must be a resident of a rural area
Applicant must be a small trader or vendor from the rural poor class
Applicant must not have defaulted on any prior government loans
benefits_summary: Interest‑free loan of up to ₹10,000 along with entrepreneurship development training for rural small traders and vendors.
